Use when the task ID is `task-c638a9a1`. Inputs are 11x11, background 0, sparse 2s, and a single 3. Demos show the output preserves all input 2s and adds a large structured pattern in color 3 related to the lone 3 and the 2-marker layout. Derive the pattern afresh from the current instance; do not assume that the emitted pattern has a simple universal orientation from these three examples.

## Available demonstrations (row/column 0-indexed)
- Demo 1: input 3 at (4,5), no 2s. Output paints a structured 3 pattern, including vertical lines at columns 1,3,9 for rows 0–8; further central segments, plus full bottom row. Illustrates that a marker-free input still produces extensive shape.
- Demo 2: input 3 at (5,5), 2s at (0,2),(0,7),(2,10),(3,1),(3,8),(8,2),(8,10),(9,0),(10,5). Output preserves those 2s and paints a structured 3 motif across rows 1–9. Existing 2s can interrupt/overlay the motif.
- Demo 3: input 3 at (4,4), 2s at (0,6),(0,10),(1,1),(4,9),(5,1),(6,8),(8,0),(8,3),(9,8),(10,5). Output adds 3s at (0,2–5),(1,2),(2,2),(2,4–6),(3,2),(3,4),(3,6),(4,2),(4,4),(4,6),(5,2),(5,6),(6,2–6). All 2s preserved.

## Validated test case
Test input 11x11, single 3 at (5,6), 2s at (0,10),(1,1),(1,6),(3,1),(5,3),(5,8),(8,0),(9,1),(9,10),(10,6). The accepted output preserved every 2 and added 3s at (3,6–8),(4,6),(4,8); central original 3 at (5,6) remains. Exact accepted rows:
```
00000000002
02000020000
00000000000
02000033300
00000030300
00020030200
00000000000
00000000000
20000000000
02000000002
00000020000
```

## Caution from rejected attempt
A near-identical output was rejected when it omitted the 3 at (4,6), and also mis-copied the bottom-right 2 from (9,10) to (9,9). The accepted correction added that missing 3 and preserved the 2 at its true source coordinate. Preserve exact input markers and validate cell coordinates mechanically. Since the complete generating rule remains underdetermined by the demos, do not treat the accepted test's small addition as a complete general rule."
}
